instruction: List all PDF files in the Papers folder in an Excel file. Use column A for full filename (with .pdf) and column B for just the topic name (part after underscore, before .pdf). Include headers 'Full Name' and 'Topic'. Save as ~/topics.xlsx

command: import pyautogui; import time; time.sleep(0.5); pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5)

llm_judge_reasons: Complete coverage: Evaluator checks all instruction requirements including row count, headers, filenames, and topics
Correct header verification: Metric checks that first row contains exactly ['Full Name', 'Topic'] as required by instruction
Correct filename verification: Metric checks column A (index 0) for all 4 expected PDF filenames with .pdf extension
Correct topic verification: Metric checks column B (index 1) for all 4 expected topics extracted from filenames (part after underscore, before .pdf)
Proper data extraction: Getter correctly extracts all rows from the Excel file and returns as list of lists
Robust comparison logic: Metric normalizes strings (strips whitespace, lowercase) and uses set comparison to verify all expected values are present
Good edge case handling: Handles empty data, None values, and allows extra rows beyond the 4 required entries
Appropriate postconfig: Activates the topics.xlsx window and saves file with Ctrl+S before verification
Correct partial scoring: Uses (passed_checks / total_checks) to give partial credit for multi-step task
